source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

mx.teacher_note: Side length is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Decide that three corresponding side lengths are sufficient to' is answered as side length rather than triangle.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Side length is what produces triangle, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Decide that three corresponding side lengths are.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: triangle is settled by running 'Decide the correct correspondence of vertices, sides, and angles when': In a congruence statement, the first, second, and third vertices of one triangle — on the item about Decide that three corresponding side lengths are.

mx.name: operation_confusion
mx.teacher_note: Triangle is computed by squaring side length and leaving triangle linear, so the written value is 33 — on the item about Decide that three corresponding side lengths are.

intelligence.enrichment: If two triangles have the same corresponding side lengths, then they are congruent; this is the SSS condition.
